## A tested mechanism for this card — the guard already exists in the repo

Measured by the at-tier contract reviewer of PR #18492 while answering the same question this card asks (record: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/18492#issuecomment-5701895373, flag F2). It is a concrete answer, not a proposal: both legs were run.

**The gap, restated precisely.** `check:objectui-pin-citations` distinguishes two spellings (gate L43-53): an **asserting** citation is checked against `.objectui-sha`, a **historical** one is *recorded and not checked, by design*. Every tier-anchored sentence #17670 is landing cites in the HISTORICAL spelling, so at the `.objectui-sha` bump that absorbs objectui `bd09957380` those sentences will describe a renderer the repo no longer builds against and **nothing mechanical reds**. Head run at PR #18492's head: 26 asserting (all matching `53ded82bf7`) / 38 historical recorded, exit 0, across 1451 spec sources.

**The tested fix.** Rewrite the TSDoc citation into the ASSERTING spelling — the reviewer used, verbatim:

> At the pin we build against (`.objectui-sha` = `53ded82bf7`) the renderer emits the widest tier's class only

- With that spelling and today's pin: **exit 0**, 27 asserting / 37 historical. Green today, no false alarm.
- With a non-pin sha planted: **exit 1** — `1 spec source(s) assert an objectui pin this repo does NOT build against … view.zod.ts:2615 cites bd09957380`.

So the pin bump itself reds on the line, and the bump author is forced to re-read the sentence. That is exactly the "nothing guards the tier claims at the bump" hole this card was opened for, closed with a gate that already ships — no new checker, no new ratchet.

**Scope note.** The reviewer offered this as *recommended, not blocking*, and the seat kept it out of PR #18492's remediation round (that round is fenced to R1–R5, the false-clause fix). It belongs here, where the tracked edge is.

**Also on this edge, filed separately:** #18516 — the unchanged `span: 'auto'` clause carries the same pin-anchored tier behaviour for wide widgets (1 of 2 cells at @md at the pin, whole row at every multi-column tier after the bump), so whoever adopts the asserting spelling should sweep that sentence in the same pass.

Dedupe words: `check:objectui-pin-citations asserting spelling`, `.objectui-sha bump reconcile`, `historical citation recorded not checked`, `spanLadderFor`, `span-full-tier-ladder`.
